observations.text: Unit of work = Project → Canvas (many per project, 'New Canvas') → Node. Node types observed: text, image, video, audio, threed ('3D World'), Image Editor (rendered as image node), agent-created 'Generate Image'.

Node = generator + result holder: each node carries prompt (TipTap), model select, params, variations, Generate, cost in Tapies; the result renders inside the same node and the bar stays for regeneration.

Selection: single click selects one node; empty-pane click deselects; on select → floating toolbar above node + title input + generation bar below + Reference handle; selected nodes are pushed as context chips into the agent composer.
Add Nodes palette: Text / Image / Video / Audio / 3D; Utilities: Timeline Editor (Beta), 3D Studio, Image Editor; Add Source: Upload.

Text node toolbar: Background Color, H1/H2/H3, Paragraph, Bold, Italic, Bullet/Ordered List, Divider, Pin, Copy All, Save to Library, Fullscreen. Text generator model default Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite (LLM list with 'Low cost / 5~10s' tags).

Image node: default Seedream 5.0 Lite 1:1·2K 1× cost 5; params popover Quality 2K/3K + Aspect 1:1…21:9; ~22 image models. After generation toolbar: Crop, Change Angle, Redraw, Relight, View All, Pin, Save to Library, Download, Full Screen.

Change Angle / Relight / Redraw render INLINE inside the node (cube with Rotation/Tilt/Scale/Wide-Angle; KEY LIGHT Global/Brightness/Color Temperature/Main Light/Rim Light; mask Brush/Marquee/Eraser + 'Describe what you want to change' + model Banana Pro cost 15).

Video node: default Seedance 2.0 Mini, 'Frames · 16:9 · 480p · 5s' cost 30; params: Generate method Frames | Omni Reference; Aspect; Resolution 480p/720p; Duration 4–15s; Generate Audio On/Off; toolbar Upload, Point to Edit, First Frame, Last Frame; ~50 video models.
Audio node: prompt + lyrics, models Mureka V8/O2, Seed audio 1.0, MiniMax Music 2.6, ElevenLabs V3, Sonilo; scene 'Music'; cost 10.
3D node ('3D World'): model Marble 1.1; toolbar Upload, Pin.

Generation lifecycle (manual): Generate disabled until prompt → click → ~39s → image lands in node; no confirm dialog; History drawer gains a dated entry. No textual progress state observed in DOM (U: visual spinner).
Share menu: Publish to TapTV / Share by link ('Anyone with the link can view and copy your template') / Move to team projects.

History drawer = generation output history (Image/Video/Audio/3D tabs, search, Select → Apply to Canvas / Download) — not document version history. Canvas has Undo/Redo (⌘Z/⇧⌘Z) only; no version/branch UI observed (U).
Comment mode toggle on dock (EnableCommenting) — collaboration annotation mode exists; content not exercised.
Timeline Editor and 3D Studio: clicking the palette items produced no node/URL change in this tab; likely open a separate window/page.
